lines.trans: Huimei said today that so she doesn't hurt Twelve Singers and the Golden Class, she has decided to withdraw.
Give me time to think of another way.
Mr Chun Yuqiao, it's time to take your stomach medicine.
Who says I forgot our pier appointment? That night, I went.
So in your eyes, the two of us have never been the same kind of people?
How could I ever harbor wild ideas — I never would.

lines.trans: You are my executive, my senior alumnus, and my idol; the gap between us is huge, and I should learn from you.
I understand — everything is crystal clear now. You are a qualified employee; let's simply work together professionally.
Please don't always say nothing's wrong; if anything is bothering you inside, tell me.
We were never the same kind of people in the first place — not in the past, and even less so now.
Outside of work, nothing matters to me at all. So as of right now, our pact is dissolved.
What did you just say?
